item.title: Bulletin updated at 17:45 HKT 14/Dec/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon and a rainband, it will be cold over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. An intense winter monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China overnight on Friday. It will be windy and further become colder over the region during the weekend and early next week. The weather will improve.

Date/Month: 15/12 (Thursday)
Wind: North to northeast force 4 to 5.
Weather: It will be cold. Cloudy to overcast with a few rain patches.
Temp range: 12 - 16 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium Low

Date/Month: 16/12 (Friday)
Wind: North force 4, force 5 later, up to force 6 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: Cloudy with a few rain patches. Temperatures will fall progressively at night.
Temp range: 14 - 18 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 17/12 (Saturday)
Wind: North force 5 to 6, occasionally up to force 8 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: Becoming cold. Dry with sunny periods.
Temp range: 10 - 15 C
R.H. range: 45 - 70 per Cent
PSR: Low
